task_summary: Fix CVE-2025-32433 in Erlang/OTP SSH server by adding authentication check to ssh_connection.erl to block pre-auth connection protocol messages
decomposition_rationale: This is a single well-defined code patch task: inserting one pattern-matching clause into one Erlang source file. The vulnerability, fix location, and exact code change are precisely documented. A single skill covering vulnerability identification and patching is sufficient.

skills.name: evo-erlang-ssh-cve-patch
skills.description: Identifies and patches CVE-2025-32433 in Erlang/OTP SSH server source code by inserting an authentication-state check in ssh_connection.erl that rejects connection protocol messages (IDs >= 80) received before authentication is complete. The fix adds a pattern-matching clause for handle_msg/4 that matches unauthenticated server connections and returns a disconnect tuple.
skills.responsibility: Locate lib/ssh/src/ssh_connection.erl in the OTP source tree, find the handle_msg/4 function clauses, verify the vulnerability exists (no authenticated=false guard), and insert the correct catch-all clause after the ssh_msg_disconnect handler but before any channel/connection message handlers.
